Hiring an NDT company in Houston: how providers differ, urgent call-outs and searches that need another service

Searches such as "ndt inspection services", "ndt companies in Houston" and "hire ndt inspection company" return a long list of firms that look alike on paper. They differ in three ways that matter to a buyer: whether the work happens in a laboratory or at your site, which methods they actually staff, and who signs off the procedures and reports. Sorting providers on those three points narrows a Houston shortlist quickly.

Laboratory work, site services and specialists

Some Houston providers are built around a laboratory. Mistras's Houston in-lab branch lists 25 work bays and 13 radiography bunkers able to shoot through 16 inches of steel, with immersion UT, MT, PT, visual, PMI and hardness testing on day and night shifts. Parts travel to the lab. Site services work the other way: a crew with portable equipment goes to the unit, tank, pipe rack or shop floor. National firms such as Mistras, Acuren and IRISNDT offer both, with Texas branches, rope access teams and engineering groups. Many smaller Houston firms specialize in tanks, rope access or one industry, and Level III consultancies and training schools write procedures and train technicians without running field crews.

Atlantis is a site services provider for conventional NDT: UT thickness and weld UT, MT, PT and VT, with procedures signed off and reports checked by an ASNT NDT Level III. It runs no laboratory, and it does not perform radiography in the United States.

Searches that point to a different kind of supplier

  • High pressure gas testing and external pressure testing are laboratory qualification tests on components, run by test laboratories such as Element's Houston facilities. The difference between those tests and vessel NDE is explained on pressure vessel inspection in Houston.
  • NDT calibration services and NDT equipment repair come from instrument manufacturers' service centers and calibration laboratories. Atlantis keeps calibration records for the instruments its crews use but does not calibrate or repair customers' equipment.
  • Emergency NDT services after a leak, fire, storm or failed hydrotest need a crew and a clear scope. Tell us the asset, the damage and the access situation; we reply within one business day and confirm a mobilization date before anyone travels. Having the equipment isolated, the permit route agreed and the last inspection readings to hand removes most of the delay.

What conventional NDT answers on a Houston job

UT thickness gives remaining wall at a condition monitoring location, measured to ASME Section V Article 23 practice. Shear-wave UT finds lack of fusion and cracks inside welds under Article 4. MT, to Article 7, finds surface-breaking cracks in carbon steel such as caustic or amine cracking at weld toes. PT, to Article 6, does the same on stainless and nickel alloys. VT under Article 9 records condition, fit-up and weld profile. Acceptance comes from the code the owner names: API 510, 570 or 653 for equipment in service, ASME Section VIII or B31.3 for new construction, AWS D1.1 for structural steel. Most turnaround, storm-damage and fabrication-shop scopes in Houston can be planned around those five examinations.

Questions to put to any Houston NDT company

  • Will the technicians on site be certified Level II in the methods you need, under a written practice you can read?
  • Who is the ASNT Level III behind the procedures, and will that person review your report?
  • Does the quote list each method, the procedure revision and the acceptance code, or just a crew count?
  • Can the company export readings into your inspection data system by CML or weld number?
  • Has the crew already completed, or can it complete, the safety prequalification and site orientation your plant requires?
  • When will the report be issued? Agree the date in writing.

How Atlantis works in Houston

Atlantis is based in Houston, so walkdowns and scope meetings across the metro are easy to attend. Method pages for the city: ultrasonic testing, magnetic particle testing, penetrant testing and visual testing. For shop work see vendor inspection in Houston, and for written practices and procedures ASNT Level III consulting. Send the asset, method, code and dates through the Houston NDT enquiry.
